title: RENSA: Rich Environment Metadata to Navigate Shared and Distributed Endpoints for Automated Federated SPARQL Query Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.28963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The number of knowledge graph databases has increased significantly with the proliferation of knowledge graph technologies. Knowledge graphs enable the dynamic integration of distributed data through federated SPARQL queries. However, constructing efficient queries in a federated environment is challenging due to the lack of detailed structural knowledge across decentralized datasets. While standards like VoID provide basic metadata, they often fail to capture the complex interlinks and authority distributions necessary for optimization. Consequently, current engines frequently rely on runtime ASK queries for source selection, increasing communication overhead. We propose RENSA, a federated SPARQL query generation framework that leverages an extension of SPARQL Builder Metadata (SBM). translated_title: RENSA：利用丰富环境元数据导航共享与分布式端点以自动生成联邦SPARQL查询
translated_abstract: 随着知识图谱技术的普及，知识图谱数据库的数量显著增长。知识图谱通过联邦SPARQL查询实现分布式数据的动态集成。然而，由于缺乏对去中心化数据集的详细结构知识，在联邦环境中构建高效查询极具挑战性。虽然像VoID这样的标准提供了基本元数据，但它们往往无法捕获优化所需的复杂互链接和权限分布。因此，当前的查询引擎经常依赖运行时的ASK查询来进行数据源选择，从而增加了通信开销。我们提出了RENSA，一个利用SPARQL Builder Metadata（SBM）扩展的联邦SPARQL查询生成框架。通过集成类和权限信息，将主语和宾语的使用映射到特定的谓词，RENSA能够实现精确的数据源选择和语义……
tldr: RENSA框架通过扩展SPARQL Builder Metadata（SBM），利用包含类、权限信息以及主宾语与谓词映射关系的丰富环境元数据，实现联邦SPARQL查询中精确的数据源选择，从而避免运行时ASK查询带来的通信开销。
en_tdlr: RENSA is a federated SPARQL query generation framework that extends SPARQL Builder Metadata (SBM) with rich environment metadata—including class and authority information and subject/object-to-predicate mappings—to enable precise source selection and reduce the communication overhead caused by runtime ASK queries.
